response.title: Hippowdon
paragraphs: Hippowdon is a slow, durable support setter with 215 HP, 154 Defense, and 124 Special Defense. Sand Stream brings in Sandstorm, while Leftovers provides end-of-turn recovery. Stealth Rock pressures opposing switches; Yawn can discourage an opponent from staying in, and Whirlwind can force a switch. Earthquake is its sole damaging move, so its direct offensive options are limited.

Its Ground typing leaves it weak to Water, Grass, and Ice, though the supplied teammates offer useful defensive support against those attacks. Lucario Mega Z resists Ice, while Salamence Mega, Archaludon, and Meowscarada resist Water. Hippowdon’s slower Speed makes it better suited to establishing hazards or disrupting opponents than to racing faster attackers.

recommendations.title: Use Lucario Mega Z as an Ice-resistant switch-in when Hippowdon is threatened by Ice attacks.
recommendations.reason: Hippowdon is weak to Ice, while Lucario Mega Z resists it, giving the team a concrete defensive option against that threat.

recommendations.title: Use Stealth Rock to support Hippowdon’s switching pressure from Yawn and Whirlwind.
recommendations.reason: Stealth Rock damages foes when they switch in, while Yawn discourages staying in and Whirlwind forces a switch. Together, these moves can make repeated switches costly.
